newsitem.title: DUBAI: Five people die in Iran mosque stampede.
newsitem.headline: Five people die in Iran mosque stampede.

text.p: Five people were killed and 44 injured when worshippers stampeded at the entrance to a mosque in western Iran, the Iranian news agency IRNA said on Sunday.

Crowds were gathering at the mosque in the city of Kermanshah on Saturday night for prayers marking the end of their day-long Moslem fast when the stampede took place, said the agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
The dead included two girls aged seven and 13.
Many Moslems go to the mosque during the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan, which began on January 11 in Iran, to break their fast and pray.
